🧠 Brain Games & Classic Puzzle Games in One App
Looking for a quick puzzle, a relaxing card game, or a classic challenge?
Brain Games: 15+ Puzzle Games brings a growing collection of classic puzzle games, brain games, board games, card games, and arcade games together in one app.
Play a quick game during a break, challenge yourself with a difficult puzzle, or switch between different classics whenever you want.
One app. Many classic games. Your next challenge is waiting.
🧩 Puzzle & Brain Games
Sudoku
Solve classic Sudoku puzzles and challenge your logic with increasingly difficult boards. A timeless number puzzle for players who enjoy thinking, solving, and improving their skills.
2048
Slide and merge matching numbers to create larger tiles and reach 2048. Easy to learn, difficult to master, and perfect for a quick brain challenge.
Minesweeper
Use logic and deduction to uncover the board while avoiding hidden mines. Can you clear the entire board?
15 Puzzle
Slide numbered tiles and arrange them in the correct order. Plan your moves carefully and try to solve each puzzle efficiently.
Klotski
Move blocks strategically and find the solution to challenging layouts. A classic logic puzzle for players who enjoy planning ahead.
Nonogram
Use numbers and logic to reveal hidden pixel-art pictures. Solve each grid and discover the image hidden inside.
Tetris
Arrange falling blocks, complete lines, and keep the board clear. A classic puzzle game that's easy to understand and challenging to master.
Color Sort
Sort colorful objects into the correct groups and enjoy a relaxing combination of colors, patterns, and simple puzzle gameplay.
 Classic Board & Strategy Games
Enjoy timeless board games and strategy challenges in the same app.
Yahtzee
Roll the dice and create high-scoring combinations. A classic dice game that's easy to pick up and fun to replay.
Tic Tac Toe
Play the classic Tic Tac Toe game and plan your moves carefully. Simple rules, quick rounds, and plenty of strategic possibilities.
Dots & Boxes
Draw lines, capture boxes, and try to outsmart your opponent. A simple classic that rewards careful planning.
Connect Four
Drop your pieces and connect four in a row before your opponent. Easy to learn, but every move matters.
🃏 Card & Arcade Games
Want something different?
Play Solitaire when you want a relaxing card game, or switch to Snake for a quick arcade challenge.
